title: How many SKUs?
context: The Stock table (rows 2-41) has one row per item. Ops wants to know how many items are tracked.
task: How many distinct SKUs are listed in the Stock table?
hint: Count the SKU codes down the first column — they are text.

title: Total units on hand
context: The warehouse wants the total quantity of stock sitting on shelves.
task: How many units are on hand in total across every SKU?
hint: Find the column that holds the quantity on hand and total it.

title: Stock value of one SKU
context: Finance values held stock as unit cost times the quantity on hand.
task: What is the value of the stock held for the item in row 2?
hint: Multiply that row's unit cost by its quantity on hand.

title: Total inventory value
context: Finance needs the value of the whole warehouse in one figure.
task: What is the total value of all inventory on hand, valuing each item at its unit cost?
hint: Multiply cost by quantity for every row and add the results in a single step.

title: Out-of-stock items
context: Ops wants to know how many lines have run dry.
task: How many SKUs have zero units on hand?
hint: Count the rows whose on-hand quantity equals zero.

title: Electronics lines
context: The Electronics category manager wants their line count.
task: How many SKUs belong to the Electronics category?
hint: Count the rows whose category equals Electronics.

title: A-class items
context: ABC analysis flags the most important items as class A.
task: How many items are classified as A?
hint: Count the rows whose ABC class equals A.

title: Hardware on hand
context: The Hardware category manager wants total stock for their range.
task: How many units are on hand across all Hardware items?
hint: Sum the on-hand quantity, but only for rows where the category is Hardware.

title: Units received
context: The Movements log (rows 2-81) records every stock movement by type.
task: How many units were received in total across all inbound (IN) movements?
hint: Sum the movement quantity, filtered to rows where the type is IN.

title: Units shipped
context: The Movements log records outbound shipments as OUT rows.
task: How many units were shipped out in total across all outbound (OUT) movements?
hint: Sum the movement quantity, filtered to rows where the type is OUT.

title: Dashboard-ready average cost
context: The dashboard shows the typical unit cost to two decimal places.
task: What is the average unit cost across all SKUs, rounded to 2 decimals?
hint: Average the unit-cost column, then round the result.

title: Are A items pricier?
context: Merchandising suspects class-A items cost more per unit.
task: What is the average unit cost of the A-class items?
hint: Average the unit cost, filtered to rows whose ABC class is A.

title: Largest single receipt
context: Receiving wants to know the biggest inbound delivery on record.
task: What is the largest single quantity received on any one inbound (IN) movement?
hint: Find the maximum quantity, restricted to rows where the type is IN.

title: Fastest supplier
context: The Suppliers table (rows 2-7) lists each supplier's lead time in days.
task: What is the shortest supplier lead time, in days?
hint: Look for the minimum in the lead-days column.

title: Reorder or OK?
context: An item needs reordering once stock falls to or below its reorder point.
task: Label the item in row 2 "Reorder" if its on-hand quantity is at or below its reorder point, otherwise "OK".
hint: A single IF comparing the on-hand cell to the reorder-point cell.

title: Stock-out warning
context: A helper column flashes a warning for items that have run out.
task: For the item in row 2, show "STOCKOUT" if its stock is zero or negative, otherwise leave the cell blank.
hint: An IF whose test is on-hand at or below zero, with an empty string for the else.

title: Days of cover
context: Days of cover is how long current stock lasts at the item's daily demand.
task: For the item in row 2, how many days of cover does its on-hand stock give at its daily demand rate, to 1 decimal?
hint: Divide the on-hand quantity by daily demand, then round to one place.

title: Supplier name for a SKU
context: The Suppliers table (Q2:U7) maps each SupplierID to its name.
task: What is the name of the supplier for the item in row 2?
hint: Match the item's supplier ID into the Suppliers table and pull back the name column.

title: Lead days for a SKU
context: Planning needs to know how long the item in row 2 takes to restock.
task: How many lead days does the supplier of the item in row 2 quote?
hint: Match the supplier ID into the Suppliers table; work out which column holds lead days.

title: Cost of a named SKU
context: A cost check needs the unit cost for one specific SKU.
task: What is the unit cost of SKU010?
hint: Look up SKU010 in the Stock table and return its unit-cost column.

title: SKU number
context: A join needs the numeric part of the SKU code as a real number.
task: Extract the numeric part of the SKU code in row 2 as a number (e.g. SKU001 becomes 1).
hint: Take the last three characters, then convert that text into a number.

title: Item label
context: Build a label like "SKU001 · Item 1" for the item in row 2.
task: Join the SKU code, a " · " separator, and the item name for row 2.
hint: Use & to stitch the pieces together.

title: Category code
context: Reports use a short 3-letter category code in capitals.
task: Build a 3-letter upper-case code from the category of the item in row 2 (e.g. Hardware becomes HAR).
hint: Take the first three letters, then force upper case.

title: Month of first movement
context: Monthly reporting needs the month of the earliest logged movement.
task: What month number (1-12) is the first movement in the log dated?
hint: Extract the month from that movement's date.

title: Span of the log
context: Movement dates are stored as serial numbers, so subtracting them gives days.
task: How many days span between the earliest and latest movement in the log?
hint: Subtract the smallest movement date from the largest.

title: Activity at WH-A
context: The WH-A warehouse manager wants their movement count.
task: How many movements took place at warehouse WH-A?
hint: Count the movement rows whose warehouse equals WH-A.

title: Stock adjustments
context: Audit wants to know how often stock was manually adjusted.
task: How many movements are adjustments (ADJ)?
hint: Count the rows whose movement type equals ADJ.

title: Critical item?
context: A flag marks items that are both class A and below their reorder point.
task: For the item in row 2, return TRUE only if it is A-class AND its stock is at or below its reorder point.
hint: Combine two conditions that must both hold.

title: Needs attention
context: An item needs attention if it has no stock or no daily demand.
task: For the item in row 2, return TRUE if its stock is zero or negative OR its daily demand is zero.
hint: Either condition being true is enough.

title: Most expensive item
context: Merchandising wants the highest unit cost in the catalogue.
task: What is the highest unit cost across all SKUs?
hint: Look for the maximum in the unit-cost column.

title: Safety-days rule
context: The Rules table (W2:X4) stores planning parameters as name/value pairs.
task: What value is set for the "Safety days" rule?
hint: Match the rule name in the Rules table and return its value column.

title: On-time rate as percent
context: A scorecard shows each supplier's on-time rate as a whole-number percentage.
task: Show the on-time rate of the first supplier (row 2) formatted as a percentage.
hint: Format the decimal rate as a percent using a text function.

title: Missing warehouses
context: A data-quality check looks for movements with no warehouse recorded.
task: How many movement rows are missing a warehouse value?
hint: Count the blank cells in the warehouse column.

title: Share of units on hand
context: How concentrated is stock in the first item?
task: What share of all on-hand units does the item in row 2 hold? (Return the fraction.)
hint: Divide that item's on-hand quantity by the total on hand across all SKUs.
